3musketeers5

Authentic Vietnamese dishes, reasonable price, good services
Feb 2023
I stumbled on this restaurant while searching on the net for authentic VN foods for dinner. Upon narrowing down to 3 options, I started to read reviews from various outlets (local reviewers, Tripadvisor, local travelers..) I decided to give this restaurant a go.
- Location: Near the popular bar hoping (Pho Bui Vien) so it's very busy. There are 2 restaurants in the same building. This one is on the bottom where a steak restaurant is on the top. 
- Reservation: I recommend to make a RSVP, if you have a party of 4. Even for 2, it's best to do that so there is no waiting. I did see many people came in while we were dining and walked out b/c of no RSVP and seatings were full. 
- Foods quality: Excellent! Based on the dishes we ordered. Simple authentic Vietnamese dishes that we were craving for. :). There were so many good options and it took us longer than usual to narrow to 5 dishes w/2 fresh coconuts. The coconut juice was cold, sweet and very refreshing. Top of the coconut thick skin was chopped off and insert the straw, ready to sip. :). Just the way it should be to enjoy a fresh coconut.
1. Stir fried morning glory w/garlic (Rau Muon Xao Toi). Too much of the tube section, not enough balance of tube and leaves. It still tasted very good!! 
2. Caramelized pork (requested no fat) in clay pot (Thit tieu kho to). Yummy!! Just the right balance of not too saulty, enought sauce for dipping with right amount of spicy kick.
3. Calamari with tamarind sauce (Muc chien gion). This was a little well done, calamari became too chewy. Plus, it would be better if the batter is more flaky and thinner. This was the least favorite of all dishes ordered.
4. Mango salad with grilled prawn (Goi xoai voi tom nuong). Excellent due to the sauce is done right. Mangoes were cut in larger strips instead of the usual shredded style. We prefer this version. The grilled prawn size was good, not your typical smaller shrimp. Definitely recommend!
5. Sticky rice with banana and coconut (Chuoi nep nuong cot dua tuoi). The restaurant added the crunchy coconut to this desert provided a good balance of softness and chewy of the grilled banana along with the crunchiness of the coconut all in one spoon. :) It's also not too sweet and fresh.

I reduced from a 5 to 4 star due to the morning glory veggie dish, and well done calamari dishes. Giving so many choices in the city, one could dine and not have to go back for months. Yet, we will sure come back the next time when we are in town as the first place to dine along with opportunity to try other dishes we wrote in out journal.
- Services: Very prompt and dishes came out hot even the restaurant is full. At time, you do experience this when the restaurant is full capacity, service and foods quality will be impacted.
- Restaurant accepts credit card which is nice. Many restaurants do not, which are fine but this type of restaurant with certain level of service, quality, cost and comfort is a must for tourists. Restaurant also offers vegetarian dishes, which are great! Lots of dishes with tofu, will try the next time.

Den_Long_SG
Nope…for those who looking for an air conditioner restaurant where staffs speak English impeccably, high quality of food ingredients with a street price.

I’m sorry you feel this way. Some people don’t realize how difficult it is to make a dollar in the restaurant industry, they just look at the food cost and think they could do it for less but take this into consideration. We pay approximately $126.000 in product costs yearly; $96.000 a year in house rent, $105,000 a year for management wages, managers, brewers, chefs, and none of that goes to ownership and I have not even listed the other so many cost accounts, 8% food taxes, F&B business licenses, health department licenses, 10% alcohol production taxes, light bulbs, point of sale system, management information system costs, software, hardware, menu covers, menu paper, and there is so much more that I can’t even think of it all right now.
This is not the greedy owner trying to fleece those who looking an air-conditioner restaurant with street food price, it is a legitimate business that employs 51 people in the most crowded city in Vietnam, pays its employees well, and pays all of its taxes, values its guests, the guests that value good service and good food. If my goal was to fleece anyone, my restaurants would never survive…it’s my hope that I’m able to provide people a great place to work, a great place to enjoy their friends and family, a great place that travelers can taste Vietnamese food with good service, staffs can speak English very well.

If 500.000 VND for two people is too much to pay, then I’m sorry. But I think most people will realize that this is a cost of doing business the right way at a high level and will be willing to support us. As you could see on the day you visited, we have a lot of locals and a restaurant with full of locals clearly shows that the price is affordable and the food is authentic.

Moreover, as we know there are so many places to travel the world but you come to our country. That’s why we well prepared a todo list for those who wants to discover the city but magically so quickly you disappointed with that. Our Vietnamese hospitality kinda gave it away.

All in all, thank you for choosing lovely Vietnam and may the luck be ever in your favor

We then ordered squid, belly pork, pak choy with mushrooms and steamed rice. I was advised the squid was very spicy, so I asked if it would be possible to tone that down. Maybe not as great as its reputation
Feb 2019 • Couples
We met this couple from Germany at the hotel where we stay while visiting Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam. They encouraged us to visit and eat at the Den Long as being the best Vietnamese restaurant in HCMC. We had some difficulty to find the place but as soon as we walked in, we loved the decor and the atmosphere. A friendly welcome was a good start. The host explained the menu in details and we ordered some of the food we were familiar with and waiting to order more according to what we had for a start.

We call it the summer rolls (shrimp with cold noodles and salad or chive on thin rice paper). 4 of them with a tablespoon of peanut sauce. Then their crispy chicken, a thin slice of chicken battered with what I call a cereal batter. The rolls were very chewy and tasteless same as the sauce. The chicken was not better and we decided to stop ordering more food.

We were both very disappointed. Maybe we expected too much after reading some of the comments on TA .

No, not a place where we would return and definitely not a place we would recommend.

Sorry but after 2 weeks visiting different cities, we found many restaurants, much better every p’ace We went

Tourist trap rubbish
Jan 2019 • Couples
I should've heeded the reviews on here, but alas I'm dumb and did not. We spent 450,000VND on bland, pre-cooked and reheated food.

We ordered the spring rolls, crispy chicken with passion fruit chilli dipping sauce (gag), the pan fried morning glory and lemon grass chicken.

The pan fried morning glory was actually very nice, and might have been cooked fresh. The spring rolls might have been cooked to order since they were boiling hot when we bit into them. They were bland. Every thing else was barely above room temperature which means it was either cooked and reheated, or cooked in advance and left under a warmer

The lemon grass chicken was tepid. 2 of the pieces were moist and jucy whereas the rest was tough and dry as though it had been cooked to death and reheated.

The crispy chicken was nothing more than half a chicken breast schnitzel with no seasoning in the bread crumb, it was tepid and the crumb falling off from the chicken. The dipping sauce was a questionable mixture of sweet chilli and passion fruit that one might expect from a Kitchen Nightmares episode. Yes I did see the photo of it in the menu but was hoping to be wowed by some fusion flavours. 

I don't understand how, but the kitchen was so slow at sending out dishes that there was a good 5-10 minute interval between dishes. They should all be coming out together or only a short wait.

The waiter asked us how our food was, when I said average he just said "ok" and walked off... Very unprofessional but to be expected from a tourist trap. I don't blame him, I blame the owners and management. Maybe they should try eating this over priced crap before feeding it to the public.

The only reason I rated it poor and not terrible is because I didn't get sick eating here.

Den_Long_SG
Hi Ellie,

Thank you very much for coming with us and taking your time to rate for us on TripAdvisor. We encourage customer to share their experience in either positive or negative perspective but personally, I felt a bit upset after reading your review. There are lot of ways to describe about a listing but hate speech with personal insult like 'rubbish' or 'crap' should not be claimed for a good reputation restaurant like us.

First of all, I apologize for any bad feelings that you may got in our restaurant but it seems like you started the meal with a bad mood and it lead everything down. There was confliction of comments, you ordered 4 courses and three among them was boiling when serving it to your table so certainly, it was fresh and only cooked after ordering.
Secondly, we are home-cooked family run restaurant and the food comes after 5 minutes was perfectly timing. You had two starters and it came after 10 minutes after ordering, then 10 minutes later the main was served. I am so sorry if we can not delivery food at the same time like Macca's chains.
About the service, my waiter came to your table and ask if everything was good so far and you answered "It was ok, thank you" so he walked away without asking you more. I wish you could tell us directly about all of these things and we could fix it all to match your expectations.
About the price, I regret if it did not match your budget. With high house rent ($8'000/month), selected high quality ingredients and skilled staffs, our price is considered perfect. If our goal was to fleece anyone, our restaurant would never survive. It’s my hope that I’m able to provide people a great place to work, a great place for customer to enjoy with their friends and family, and a great place that supports traveler's community.

Above all, we never trap or trick anyone and we won't. Consistency is a best and clearest way to evaluate a customer - oriented restaurant. As you can see on TripAdvisor - Google - Facebook - Local Channel with over 95% good and above feedbacks (from thousands customers all around the world), consistently review from Dec 2016, I am strong confident that we are not only serve good traditional food but also willing to help tourists to discover our country by telling them good places to go, stories about the cultures.

All in all, I apologize for anything that mad you unsatisfied during enjoying the meal with us. We all hope you have a lovely year ahead with full of joys and happiness. 

Cheers
Dave Nguyen

Nice food in a lovely ambience!
Dec 2018 • Family
This is typical local Vietnamese restaurant that offers nice and authentic Vietnamese cuisines. Located in district 1 and within short walking distance from Ben Thanh Market, this is a highly acclaimed restaurant.

The restaurant is beautifully decorated with colourful and nice lanterns, covering 3 storeys of a shophouse, with seating tables on the 1st and 3rd floor. There is a lift but a very small one or you can climb up the narrow and winding steps.

Service was good, staff were polite, friendly and helpful, in ushering, recommending dishes, serving food.

After browsing the menu and at the recommendations from the staff, we ordered several dishes (as shown in the pictures). Well, I would say most of the ordered dishes (pineapple fried rice, pork belly, deep fried soft shell crabs and spring rolls etc) were extremely delicious and nice, well cooked and marinated with the sauces. Only one of them, the chicken, was a little over salty. The drinks were nice and refreshing too~

Well, the prices were quite reasonable (about 700K dong for all after discounts given as my local friend is it's members) and there were 5 of us. Of course, you cannot compare them with the street food or at a food center as it is considered a restaurant and true enough it is! As compared to other similar range of restaurants, it's price was fine!

We had a good dinner here and will surely revisit again in our next HCMC trip!

Den_Long_SG
Dear Taarika,

Thank you very much to you and your lovely friend for coming with us last week. We are very happy that you enjoyed the time with us and want to come back more to try more things on the menu, really appreciate that.

I apologize if the chicken meat was too tough to you. Basically, in Vietnam we have two kinds of chicken: industrial broiler chicken and free-ranger one. While industrial broiler chicken has super soft meat, the free-ranger one is a bit tough but more flavor and better for our health and we are using the free-ranger one to ensure the quality of our foods.
To making a portion of coconut rice, we panfried rice with 8oz of coconut milk (which was extracted from about 0.4lbs of fresh coconut fresh), no artificial flavor inside. The final product will be put inside a fresh new coconut shell which awake our senses of food. Up to customer requests, we can take the coconut flesh and cut it in small pieces.

All in all, it was our pleasure to have chance to serve you. We wish you all the bests and looking forward to serve you more in the upcoming future.

Worth every single penny!
Aug 2018 • Friends
This place is fantastic. We loved everything about it. When we went on the hunt for a restaurant with a great atmosphere near our accommodation, we would never have guessed to find something so good.
Reasons to visit this place: 
1) the location is perfect and very easy to reach. 
2) the interior is very pleasant and creates a chill atmosphere that fits the very welcoming character of the staff. 
3) the STAFF - everyone (at least three waiters were always ready to fulfill our wishes) was very friendly. After asking if it was our first time at the restaurant, the waiter patiently explained the menu‘s highlights as well as the vegetarian options (very important for me as a vegetarian). I even received a little, handwritten note with important Vietnamese phrases like „Good luck“ or „Thank you“ from our waitress.
4) the FOOD!! - it was very very delicious. Our waiter recommended getting two starters (one each) and two mains as well as rice. We followed his recommendation and ordered a Tofu Crepe, Stir Fried Tonkin Flower, Spring Rolls and Pork in a special homemade sauce, as well as steamed rice. It was perfect and we even had some leftovers for the next day that we could take home with us.

Concerning the prices: Of course it‘s „expensive“ in a Vietnamese point of view but in Western prices: it was 7.50 € / 8.50 US$ each for a more than enough dinner.

All in all one of the best restaurant experiences I’ve ever had.

Dear Sylinds

Den_Long_SG
Dear Anthony and your wife,

Thank you for coming with us for dinner on April 26 at 7:45PM and taking your time to write for us a review on TripAdvisor. I am glad that you satisfied with our service as well as the restaurant ambience.
About the food, I am so sorry if the food did not fit your taste. Soft shell crab is our signature and base on our reviews, everybody loves it. As its name, soft-shell crab is a culinary term for crabs that have recently molted their old exoskeleton and are still soft. This means that almost the entire crab can be eaten, rather than having to shell the crab to reach the meat so obviously, it has less crab meat than the grown one.
TripAdvisor is the most popular community for traveler and we are listed on Top 10 at Ho Chi Minh city so it is very easy to understand why we have many customers from all around the world not only Westerns but also Asian. You used it to find us and so does the others! Unfortunately on April 26, at around 7:45pm, your and your wife sat at the ground while we have four floors for the restaurant and you didn't know that we have a big local party on the second floor. Local family usually go as a big group and we always arrange them upstair for more space.
About the price, you and your wife ate Special Beef, Soft Shell Crab, Grilled Pork Ribs, Fried Rice and 3 bottles of Tiger beer and it only cost you 640K and I am so sorry if it was too expensive for you but we are a restaurant located at most expensive street (house rent $9.000 ~ AUD 12.000 per month, fresh and certificated ingredients, professional staffs) so our price is not expensive, even for locals. It is not fair if compare our restaurant to a street food or food court.

All in all, thank you for your subjective perspective. It encourages us a lot to keep up the good work! Wish you and your wife all the luck in your journey!

Regards
Dave Nguyen

Amazing experience at the Den Long! We had delicious cat fish hot pot and lemongrass chicken, along with very good iced tea's. The atmosphere was that of relaxed elegance and ease. The only drawback was a Chinese guest at the adjacent table, who continuously snorting phlegm and making all sorts of other unappetizing sounds. We were extremely close to asking to be re-seated at a different table but luckily they left. We took some dishes as the menu is clear and you can find photos to help you choosing.
We ordered soft shell crab, fried squids, green rice shrimps, fried rice into an ananas, fried rice with seafood and caramelized pork, everything served with different dressings. Mostly good food, very small portions
Dec 2017 • Friends
I have had dinner here twice. The first time was with one other person. We were impressed by the excellent service, the cheerful decor and the above average quality of the food. This fairly new restaurant seems to have jumped into first position on Trip Advisor's restaurant list for Ho Chi Minh City. The only negative on this first evening was the size of the portions in relation to the price. They were not just small, but exceptionally small. At the end of the meal, including dessert, I was still hungry. In fact I could have eaten the entire meal again. But it was nonetheless a good experience.The piece de resistance was the dessert that we chose, namely a thick coconut cream with a shot of strong black coffee on top. Delicious, if tiny.

The second dinner was a few days later with a group of around 8 people. We had booked a table, but had to wait around 15 minutes to be seated. The place was very busy. This time the smallness of the portions was remarked by all, and we had to wait a very long time for the dishes to come. We also had to add extra dishes, because everybody was still hungry after the first round. This took more time again. The excellence of the coconut cream dessert that I had promised turned out to be a disaster, as the coconut cream itself was thin and watery, and with the added coffee was just a tepid drink. It took ages to appear, and then had to be complained about. It should never have been served to us at all. The head waiter agreed with us and apologised. It was taken off the bill. 

It's still a nice place with above-average food, and ideal for people with small appetites. I would like to have given it 3 1/2 stars, but had to choose between 3 and 4. So 3 stars it is.

Clean Home Cooking
Dec 2017 • Couples
Đèn Lồng was our first restaurant stop when my husband and I got to Hồ Chí Minh City. We wanted rice dishes, but our stomachs needed time to get use to the local food again. The restaurant had to be clean. Đèn Lồng was certainly up to high cleanliness standards. Some may call that Westernized, but there's nothing wrong with not suffering. I was born in Vietnam, both of my parents are Vietnamese, my family still lives locally, and I am fluent in Vietnamese. There are many delicious food stands in Saigon; however, the need to see true Vietnamese cuisine as being a dirty street stall is almost insulting. We ordered four dishes: the mango salad with shrimp (gỏi xoài tôm 85k vnđ), soft shell crab (cua vỏ mềm rang me 125k vnđ), stir fried Tonkin flower with pork (thiên lý xào thịt heo 85k vnđ) and star fruit sour soup (canh chua khế 75k vnđ). These four dishes were all flavorful and used quality ingredients. Pork in Vietnam is especially fresh since it comes straight from the butcher usually on the same day. The price here is a little higher than the average local restaurant, yet you are paying for peace of mind. The portions are on the smaller size compared to overseas, so you can try different things. This was one of the better meals we had in Saigon. We left satisfied and will return.

Den Long deserves all the positive feedback it gets, the food is just amazing & outstanding!! If you are in Ho Chi Minh it is a must visit to try this authentic Vietnamese food cooked with superb fresh ingredients and with obvious love and care. All at a very reasonable price point. 

From the minute you walk in you have to be impressed, great attentive staff, in a bright restaurant that is immaculately clean. I presumed that the manager was a polite chap called An, who greeted us and showed us through the menu. He mentioned that it was a recent menu with some new dishes so would help point them out and recommend. The menu itself is just impressive in its smart presentation in book form. 

We tried a mix of dishes including - delicious soft shell crab. Amazing Prawns in green rice. Superb Caramelised pork. Gorgeous Tonkin flower beef. Bok Choi with mushrooms and pineapple rice where also outstanding. 

Overall I would say this is the best food and service in town and not to be missed.

Best service I've received in HCMN
Nov 2017 • Couples
This restaurant is a treat! Absolutely brilliant and worth full points. It's very well decorated and it feels very welcoming. I ate the caramelized pork with rice in a pineapple, and it was delicious! The prices are extremely good for the quality of the food. Don't expect street food prices of course, but it is still definately affordable, particularly from western/central Europe standard. Taking into the account all the coziness of the restaurant, the location, the quality of the food and niceness from EVERY waiter, you're absolutely getting your money's worth!

Speaking of the waiter service: it would be a crime not to mention how it made this restaurant stand out from any other I've been in HCMC so far. They were outstanding in every way possible. From explaining the menu, helping us deciding on what to order. By the end, they usually give tips to tourists on sites to check out in HCMC. However, since this was our last day here, we told them that we were actually going to some other places the next day, one of those places being Hanoi. And what do you know: the manager was from Hanoi, so they brought him in to our table and he gave us a bunch of really useful tips for when we get there!

That's why I loved them: they didn't really "need" to tell us anything about Hanoi, but they actually went out of their way to help us out with our travels. We didn't just eat a good meal in the restaurant; we really felt like these people cared about us having a good trip in Vietname. And that's remarkable!

This is my first review ever on TripAdvisor. That's how much I recommend them!

Food and Staff Outstanding
Oct 2017 • Friends
My friend and I stumbled upon this place walking down the street. A friendly waiter standing outside offered us a look through the menu. From the decor we could see from outside, to the pictures of the food (and acceptable prices), we were sold.

The restaurant was beautiful, but what really made the evening satisfying enough for me to write a review was how helpful the waitstaff were. Our waitress spent a few minutes going through the entire menu with us, highlighting some of their most popular dishes, and recommending others to us based on our preferences. 

We received our food and drinks in great timing, and were blown away. It was all very delicious and tasted quite fresh, made with quality ingredients. 

I looked around during the meal and noticed at one point a waiter had overhead a woman at another table say to her husband she probably needed more napkins. I noticed this because right away he turned around and brought them napkins, before they could ask.

Highly satisfied with our meal, we asked for the check. Another waiter came by and asked if we had seen much of Saigon yet. He then presented us with a hand-written, double-paged list of top attractions in the city, numbered and listed with addresses. These attractions included not only historic or tourist destinations, but also other restaurants and their dish recommendations. The back page also recommended different bars and their attractions: from live music to EDM to street drinking vendors.

Never in my travels have I been so satisfied with a meal and felt genuinely welcomed by the waitstaff. I was blown away by the hospitality. And again, the food wasn't overpriced but was delicious. 

All in all, I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Saigon. Thank you to Den Long's waitstaff as well for their careful attention to detail and making sure we enjoyed our trip.

Amazing Staff
Sep 2017 • Friends
Myself and three friends were only in the city for a few hours before we went to the airport to fly home, and we read about this place online in the train station. The minute we went in the staff were looking after us: helping us with our luggage and putting it away while we had our meal.
The restaurant was clean and spacious with very nice modern decor, while still reminding us of where we were. One girl helped us through the menu and recommended dishes. The food was incredible and it's hard to say what was the best, but the mango and mackerel salad and the fresh fish were delicious.
Then a member of staff who knew we had only just arrived in the city came over with a sheet of paper, on which they had written recommendations for everything in the city, from museums we should visit to the best places for young people to drink. We couldn't believe it! Without even asking they had taken it upon themselves to write all this information down for us and we were devastated we hadn't booked any nights in the city.
When we told them we liked the rice bowls and wanted to buy a couple to take home they gave us one each with a pair of chopsticks to match and wouldn't take any money off us. When the time came to leave the male waiters booked our taxi for us and carried our luggage to the car to wave us off.
I have never had better service anywhere and the food was fantastic and worth every penny. Definitely visit!

Hội An Lanterns and Five Stars.
Aug 2017 • Friends
To be honest I am a little over writing reviews, but do appreciate their value or course. I live permanently in SG and have developed a love of food from central Vietnam, but it was actuall visiting family who researched and found this restaurant.
For some reason I just felt this eatery was going to great, from the moment I got out of the taxi and am not sure why really as there are many attractive looking restaurants that in the end, simply just don't 'nail it'.

Charmingly decorated and impeccably clean kindled the good vibe and as we waited for friends to join us we began to get to know the staff who settled us in and ran through the well illustrated menu.

I was hugely impressed after our guests arrived that a senior member of staff suggested that we move the tables a little, in order that one of our guests was seated more comfortably and therefore made more welcome at the same time.

Endless wonderful dishes to choose from and when it arrived, filling our table bountifully, it looked even better than the menu illustrations, which is seldom the case.

Excellent food, so fresh and colorful and joyfully healthy, with drinks equally enjoyable, leaving us all feeling so privilaged and well cared for.

Matching all I have mentioned was the excellent service, from naturally caring and well trained staff who made all that was to be enjoyed cohesive and super enjoyable.

After our meal we all stepped out into the street, itself fascinating enough for us to decide to walk all the way back to the hotel, bouyed by great food and genuine care.

No need to say more!

Den_Long_SG
Dear Mr. Pi

Thank you for coming with us and we are very sorry for your bad feeling at our restaurant. It is a big surprise after reading your review. 

At first, our restaurant are located at Nguyen Trai Str. and this is the most busy in the center of city. We are listed on Trip Advisor with great reviews from customers so it's very easy to understand why we always have valued customers from all around the world everyday. When you came that night, we had 26 local customers and they were using their dinner at third floor. We have three floors with five areas total inside the restaurant and you were only look at the ground so I would say that was not true when claiming our restaurant just for tourist.

Secondly, you and your Vietnamese girlfriend came with us on Sunday night and unfortunately, we almost full of table. There was only available table at the ground, next to the door for you. After reading the menu, we had one available table at the second floor and I - the manager came to you and asked if you want to move to the second floor for cooler, more comfortable since the table next to the door always has people go out and in and then you agreed.

When you got there, my staff invited you to sit at table for two but you requested to sit at the table for four, next to the lanterns. He was kindly explained for you that this table were reserved for a group whose were on the way in. He also kept the air-conditioner fans upward but you insisted on seating at the reserved table. After that you went down, I and even the owner invited you to a private room (which are only opened for a big group) but you refused and went out.

It was unfair when you rated two bubbles after all we did. You even did not have the dinner with us. It would be great if we have a chance to serve you in the future and please contact us at denlongrestaurant@gmail.com or +84 909 949 183 for making reservation to select your favorite table.

We went to this restaurant as it had such good reviews on trip advisor. Friendly service and nice decor. I had the pineapple fried rice and the morning glory which were very nice. Written August 11, 2017
Den_Long_SG
Dear Andrea,

Thank you for choosing our restaurant and we are very sorry to hear about food poisoning from your husband. That was really bad and we hope that he will get better soon!

Den Long - Home Cooked Restaurant is a restaurant which is under controlled by the Food and Beverage Department of the city and we are strictly follow safety rules from the Department. All of our ingredients are well selected, fresh and clean and each ingredient will be kept within 24hrs as a sample for the F&B to make sure it is totally safe. It usually takes six months for a restaurant to get this certification and we got it so we are very carefully follow the procedure.

It was a little surprised when we hear the feedback about soft shell crab. We sell hundreds of portion per day and your husband was the only one who got food poisoning because of it since the day we opened the restaurant.

Our staff always asks customer to make sure they are not allergic to seafood and / or seafood intolerance before making any recommendations. In this case, even your husband eat 100% fresh and clean, he also get problem and we can not consider it as a food poisoning!

The way we cook soft shell crab, we use the fresh crab and deep fried it. The black stuff that you seen inside the crab is the pepper seasoning and crab's texture. If the food poisoning came from the soft shell crab, we believe that all of customers would had the same problem but none of them, except your husband. We din't find poison from the samples also. 

That would be great if you can list out what you ate on that day (exclude our restaurant). We are afraid of food poisoning from your husband may came from elsewhere, not from our restaurant. Please contact with us by email: denlongrestaurant@gmail.com and we can find what was exactly the reason make your husband got poisoning and we can clarify this matter from then.

All in all, we hope that your husband will get better soon. 

Best Regards
Dave Nguyen
Manager

Dainty Little Portions
Jul 2017 • Couples
We have mixed feelings about this one. On the positive side, you can get to try some unusual dishes that you will never find on the backpacker-oriented menus. Beef with tonkin flowers? We tried it and it was delicious. Our Vietnamese friend confirmed that people often eat it in the countryside but you won't often find it on Westernized menus. We also had some tasty claypot chicken and creamy tofu with chives. However, it wasn't all smooth sailing.

The portions are not just small here, they are tiny. I don't know why all the supposed mains are served in dainty little portions which would be on the small side for appetizers. After eating here, we went straight to another restaurant and ordered more food. The small sizes really were quite silly. We never eat twice on one meal but these 'meals' are just too small by half. Also, the 10% tip we gave earned nothing but a churlish frown.
Read more
Written July 18, 2017
Den_Long_SG
Dear Mr. Raymond,

First of all, we believe that you have lots of choices and we appreciate for choosing our restaurant for your dinner. I am very glad that you loved the taste and enjoyed the food at our restaurant. It seems like size of the portion was the only thing that make you felt unsatisfied and we are very sorry about that.

As the name said, Den Long - Home Cooked Vietnamese Restaurant serves traditional foods follow Vietnamese style with flavors across many regions along the country. In Vietnamese family, sharing the food is culture and we usually eat many dishes for a meal. If you have a chance to go to other Vietnamese Restaurant or local's meal, you may also be served as the similar size but with many type of foods on the table for a meal. As usual, we eat one starter, two or three main course, one vegetable, one soup, one rice for two people and I believe it will fill you up.

Secondly, the 10% on the bill was not the tips. Kindly note that in Vietnamese culture, there is no tips. The 10% was clearly described by the text "VAT" next to it and that was the VALUE ADDED TAX. This 10% didn't come from the restaurant, but the government's policy. Den Long is a "licensed" restaurant which mean it will under control by the city in terms of: Food and Beverage Quality, Safety and etc... You will find lots of restaurants out there with 10% of TAX, not only us.

In Vietnamese Culture, as always, gratuity are not required. You can tips if you like but the service and food, we ensure it will always be the same and we believe that Den Long were well deserved about all. I wish that you would ask us about 10% extra when paying so that you won't feel unhappy for the value you gave.

All in all, I really appreciated for taking time to give us your candid comments and we apologize again. We are looking forward to have an opportunity to serve you for the second time.

Best Regards
Dave Nguyen
Manager.

Nice food, great service
Jul 2017 • Friends
My friend took me to Den Long restaurant last week and this place became my favorite. I will definitely come back since I want to try everything there :D

The restaurant is attractive with decoration of colorful lanterns and some Vietnamese musical instruments inside restaurant. Prices are reasonable for quality and service. 

Staff is very friendly and they speak English well. One of them is a story-teller, he introduced Vietnamese culture and history through the decoration of restaurant as well as food ingredients. I was really impressed by his enthusiasm when he shared with us stories about Vietnamese cuisine.

The food is absolutely amazing, from taste to presentation. My favorite dishes are grapefruit salad with shrimp, pork (a great combination of sweet and sour flavour); coconut fried rice with beef and spring roll. The sauce for spring roll tastes so good and is perfectly matched with the roll. I also enjoyed the drink. They have some homemade-recipe drinks that are refreshing, tangy and good for health.

If you would like to get to know Vietnamese culture and try nice food with great service at the same time, this place is for you.

Not great
Jun 2017 • Couples
Bit of a mixed bag this place. Overall, great service, nice decor but poor location with small portion sizes of not great food. 

The service is friendly, informative and responsive, zero complaints.

The problem was the food. If it was my first taste of Vietnamese food then I may have been happy, however it's not and we were very dissapointed after such fine reviews. 

Portion sizes are small and flavours are lacking when compared to similar restaurants. The meat in the hot pot for example was tough, it should be very tender but this wasn't cooked long enough yes still managed to taste old. 

The soft shell crab could not be tasted as the Tamarind sauce was so strong and so sour, there was no balance to the sauce at all, it was like drinking tamarind paste with a few nuts and fried shallots thrown in. 

Two other dishes had the same bland sauce (garlic and oyster sauce).

The location is also not too convenient.

It's rare that I will write a negative review such as this, but felt the need to as I can't fathom why this restaurant has received so many great reviews, maybe the staffs charm?

Culinary delights from four corners of Vietnam
May 2017 • Solo
I saved my review of Den Long for after I had my third meal there. Initially I went there for a late lunch on my first day of a 4- day trip to Saigon. The place was close to my hotel and had great reviews, so seemed like a safe bet. I have had mixed experience with the restaurants which are supposed to have authentic Vietnamese food in Saigon. Some tend to be too spicy or have limited menu options or cater too much to the milder pallet of the foreigners. Den Long advertised to serve authentic Vietnamese cuisine so I had some idea as to what I should expect. The restaurant is small and on a busy and charming street. It is tastefully decorated and immaculately clean. It appears to be a family run business and the owners are anxious to engage the guests and guide them through their fairly extensive menu. It turns out that menus is a sampling of the best and most traditional dishes from all over Vietnam. The three times that I was there, I tried a dozen different dishes including seafood, pork, chicken, various spring rolls different salads and several fried rice plates. Everything is fresh, skillfully prepared and beautifully presented and sinfully delicious. Every item on the menu is interesting, unique and memorable.it will take several dining sessions to fully appreciate the full range and variety of dishes offered here, but that is one of the wonderful things about this restaurant. If you are looking for a truly unique Vietnamese dining experience in Saigon dont miss Den Long.

Inspiring Vietnam
Feb 2017 • Couples
We had not long arrived in Ho Chi Minh City and it was our first visit. We reviewed trip advisor and found this restaurant whilst only having 13 reviews impressively they were all excellent so we decided to visit as we were staying not too far away. We were delighted we did as the food and welcome were absolutely delightful. We were introduced to Dave (he is Vietnamese) and he was so pationate about his new restaurant. It has only been open 3 weeks and it was beautifully decorated with scenes and reflections from all over Vietnam. We were introduced to the menu which consisted of many authentic Vietnamese dishes. We started with the mini shirt ribs which were quite sweet in flavour but were served with a spicy sauce which complimented the dish superbly we also had the grapfruit and prawn salad which was so fresh and tasty. We followed this with 3 main dishes of Crispy Frogs Legs, 5 sauce cooked chicken and caramelised pork with prawns. This was served with a sweet apricot wine from Vietnam. The food was great and the owner and all the staff so helpful. My only criticism is the dishes are quite tricky to eat and you do need plenty of serviette as you can get messy. It is certainly worth it though you must go and see this place absolutely beautifully done.
